caption: The drawing depicts a circular object, possibly a decorative plate or embroidery design, centered on a plain background. The circular object has a beige or light tan base color with a scalloped wavy border in shades of brown and light reddish-pink. Inside the border, there is a central floral arrangement consisting of various flowers and leaves. The flowers are colored in shades of red, pink, purple, and blue, with the leaves in a mix of greens, browns, and dark blues. Each flower is distinct, featuring petal details and different shapes, and the dense grouping of flowers and leaves occupies the center of the circle, radiating outward but contained within the decorative border. The name "Lilian Morelten" is handwritten in the bottom right quadrant, near the outer edge of the circle. The overall composition is balanced and the lines and colors are applied with visible texture, suggesting the use of colored pencils or pastels.
title: Hooked Rug
